rubrics.justification: The response substantially misgraded the embryo versus the provided laboratory Gardner score of 3AA, calling it approximately 3BC/4BC with weak TE and only B-grade ICM. This is a major morphological mismatch.
It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, BMI, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm motility, and lining, and relates them to prognosis.
The reasoning is internally structured and mostly logical, but the prognosis is built on an incorrect morphology assessment, which weakens the validity of the probability estimate and conclusions.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET at age 31, luteal support, consideration of FET/freeze-all in selected settings, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Minor caution only because advice is based on an inaccurate embryo grade.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support review, cohort review, evaluation for adenomyosis/hydrosalpinx if repeated failure, and lifestyle optimization.
